name: Painterly 3D
visualIdentity: Painterly marks and controlled color masses shape 3D forms under stylized lighting. Brush direction follows form; highlights stay restrained and surface textures remain stable as camera or poses move. This is distinct from matte clay-style 3D.
suitableUses: Explicitly suited to character or environment pieces, product and explainer scenes, and cinematic framing. Inferred fit: videos or interactive HTML stories that benefit from expressive 3D renders, camera views, annotations, or chaptered storytelling.
limitations: Needs stable painterly materials and suitable 3D assets. Avoid glossy photorealism and crawling textures. Flat images cannot reveal unseen sides or support a true dolly or orbit; use labeled 2.5D or captured views when appropriate. Keep orbit bounded and compatible with projection and geometry.
palette: No intrinsic palette is specified. Optional new-artwork example: background #EFE4D1, foreground #38454A, accents #7D9A95 and #BB7C65; use as discrete tokens with no gradients. Exact task, brand, reference, semantic-role, and asset colors take precedence; preserve assignments and color families. The background/foreground pair has stated contrast 7.878; accents with foreground are decorative only. Recheck actual compositing.
motionAndInteraction: Use deterministic geometry, lighting, and camera keyframes that reveal the painted treatment. Preserve deliberate cuts, impacts, constant-speed moves, and reading holds. For video, evaluate state from seekable composition time. Interactive HTML may map bounded scroll to reversible chapters, orbit, or dolly, or pointer to bounded camera or gaze movement; provide accessible controls and reduced-motion states where relevant. Use these patterns only with supporting assets and geometry; do not force symmetry on acting or call flat-image movement a dolly.
audio: Unspecified by the style. Choose music, narration, vocals, effects, ambience, or silence for the topic and audience; honor supplied choices and assets. Synchronize through the composition pipeline and check intelligibility, balance, clipping, and picture sync.
assetRequirements: Create stylized Blender materials and stable brush textures; provide suitable models, rigs, lighting, and camera setup. Use complete geometry for camera circuits, or enough captured turntable views for a view-sequence alternative. Load fonts and local assets; cache stateful simulations or use baked frames. Native Canvas/SVG is not a substitute for needed 3D.
combinations: Use Painterly 3D alone for character or environment pieces. Optional hero-shot framing (style-104) supports calm centered environments; apply symmetry selectively, not to every shot. Editorial layout (style-019) can structure captions or HTML case studies; keep text on calm areas and avoid bold blocks or heavy ornament. Maintain palette, stable brushwork, safe margins, and readable type. Inferred: chapter transitions, narrative staging, dolly, or orbit fit only when geometry, story, and interaction support them.
productionApproach: Blender with bpy creates models, materials, lighting, deterministic animation, and renders; choose EEVEE for faster rendering or Cycles for path tracing. GSAP can own paused, seekable motion. HyperFrames is the primary composition, timing, media/audio sync, validation, and export pipeline; use Remotion only if unavailable or a verified required capability is blocked, recording why. Keep renderer, motion, and pipeline responsibilities separate. Inspect representative frames and decoded output for texture stability, timing, dimensions, and audio sync.
